dispositions.finding: Codex H1: a second takeover during rejected-disposition repair can hide the terminal outcome
dispositions.resolution: The public reader now consumes the immutable global rejected disposition directly after strict identity, epoch/owner, exact control-path, error-type and retained rejection validation. Visibility no longer depends on current-epoch repair or the hot request remaining present.

dispositions.finding: Codex M1: marker-less or null runtime evidence is accepted as clean
dispositions.resolution: Runtime evidence must contain at least one cleanliness marker and every present marker must be exact boolean false. The sole retained pre-marker P3 artifact is an exact finite path attestation, not a general compatibility rule.

dispositions.finding: Codex M2: static replay checks command kind and result but not the canonical command request
dispositions.resolution: The replay API now accepts every canonical bind-or-replace argument and delegates to the ordinary `_command_replay` digest comparison. When recovery follows a committed replacement, immutable binding history and the retained exact operator authorization reconstruct the original request. A same-kind/equal-result record with different arguments is rejected as `CommandConflictError`.
